summary: SD-LEO-INFRA-COORDINATOR-RECEIPTS-BROADCAST-CONSTRAINTS-001 is not a whole-SD duplicate, but FR-1 collides with a LIVE in_progress SD (SD-LEO-FIX-DELIVERY-RECEIPT-SEVERITY-001, escalated from QF-20260906-162, is_working_on=true, PLAN_PRD, no PRD yet) whose implementing code already merged at 98c3e7f78d8 + 77158a9ce41. FR-2 is dead by construction as specified: no reader anywhere unions target_session='broadcast'. FR-3 anchors on a function (buildWorkAssignment) that does not exist. The SD has 0 backlog rows, a GATE 1 blocker.
critical_issues: FR-1 DUPLICATE-IN-FLIGHT: SD-LEO-FIX-DELIVERY-RECEIPT-SEVERITY-001 (uuid d0402004-3fa0-489c-86cb-cb7ed6c314fc) is status=in_progress, current_phase=PLAN_PRD, is_working_on=true, created 2026-09-06T11:15Z. quick_fixes.escalated_to_sd_id on QF-20260906-162 points at it. Its scope (receipt written at coordinator inbox enumeration, plus RECEIVED/READ/ANSWERED worker rendering) is FR-1 narrowed to severity=high stuck signals. Two SDs now claim the same write site. LEAD must reconcile before approving.

QF-20260906-162 ROW IS STALE VERSUS GIT: the quick_fixes row shows status=escalated, pr_url=null, commit_sha=null, completed_at=null, yet PR #8338 merged today carrying the full implementation. Dedup on status alone misses the merged code. The FIX SD that escalation produced is very likely already satisfied by main.

FR-2 DEAD BY CONSTRUCTION AS WRITTEN: no code path in the repo reads target_session='broadcast'. Worker drains use exact-match .eq('target_session', sessionId) at scripts/hooks/coordination-inbox.cjs:668 (oldest-5 batch) and :690 (priority-exempt batch), scripts/worker-checkin.cjs:600, and lib/checkin/steps/seat-busy-fence.cjs:25. The only sentinel-union readers in the repo are role-specific: scripts/adam-advisory.cjs:432/513/708/728 (broadcast-adam), scripts/solomon-advisory.cjs:446/554 (broadcast-solomon), scripts/coordinator-quiet-tick.mjs:262/523 (broadcast-coordinator). A single row with target_session='broadcast' reaches zero worker seats. Writers already emit into this dead lane: lib/fleet/dispatch-suggestions.cjs:216, lib/npm-install-lock.cjs:73, scripts/ack-chairman-directive.cjs:106, scripts/coordinator-cold-recovery.cjs:123, scripts/coordinator-revive.cjs:136.
SD HAS 0 BACKLOG ROWS: sd_backlog_map returns zero rows for both uuid e11ede7e-db45-467c-9372-26b67bee08ff and the sd_key. GATE 1 requires at least one backlog item before status='active'.

FR-3 ANCHOR FUNCTION DOES NOT EXIST: buildWorkAssignment appears nowhere in the repo (grep across .js/.cjs/.mjs, node_modules excluded). The real choke point is insertCoordinationRow at lib/coordinator/dispatch.cjs:1214. The PRD must re-anchor FR-3 or it is unimplementable as specified.
warnings: INTERNAL SPEC CONFLICT INSIDE THE SD: the IN SCOPE text says FR-1 writes ONE receipt row, while the adopted STEP-0 rider (Solomon a6af3aab) says the preferred shape is an UPDATE on the signal row (a stamped field queued|routed:<target>|needs-decision:<who> plus receipted_at), which would make rider (a) moot. Merged QF-162 shipped the new-row shape. FR-4(d)'s zero-asserted count is specified to read that stamped field, which does not exist. PLAN must pick one shape.

RIDER (a) IS ONLY HALF-SATISFIED: PAYLOAD_KINDS.SIGNAL_RECEIPT ('signal_receipt', lib/fleet/worker-status.cjs:113) is in BACKPRESSURE_EXEMPT_KINDS (worker-status.cjs:225-229 and the Set at lib/coordinator/dispatch.cjs:39) but is NOT in INFORMATIONAL_KINDS (worker-status.cjs:289-311). Solomon's rider explicitly required INFORMATIONAL_KINDS membership because QF-20260904-695 re-points the counter at that list. Today the receipt is excluded from the counted population by dispatch.cjs:1117 via BACKPRESSURE_EXEMPT_KINDS, so the exemption holds; if QF-695 re-keys the filter onto INFORMATIONAL_KINDS without unioning the exempt list, the exemption silently regresses. FR-1's acceptance test must run against post-QF-695 code.

FR-1 SCOPE IS ROUGHLY 3x WIDER THAN WHAT MERGED: writeSignalReceipts (scripts/fleet-dashboard.cjs:1691) filters payload.signal_type==='stuck' AND payload.severity==='high'. FR-1 covers every drained worker signal, coordinator_request and advisory. Advisories and coordinator_requests drain at different sites (scripts/adam-advisory.cjs, scripts/solomon-advisory.cjs, scripts/coordinator-quiet-tick.mjs:262/523), so widening means three or more new write sites, not a predicate change.

THE RECEIPT DISPOSITION LINE IS ENTIRELY UNBUILT: FR-1 requires one line reading queued | routed:<target> | needs-decision:<who>. The merged payload carries only kind, producer, run_id, enumerated_row_id and correlation_id, plus a fixed subject string. No disposition field exists.

WORKER RENDERING IS AGE-GATED: formatOutstandingWarning (lib/fleet/outstanding-signals.cjs:197) returns null unless oldest_age_minutes >= DEFAULT_ALERT_AGE_MIN. The RECEIVED note (lines 209-218) is real and does reach the worker via lib/checkin/steps/roll-call.cjs:41, but only once a signal is already overdue. A receipt written at drain inside the SLA window is never shown. READ and ANSWERED are also not distinct rendered states: the underlying query gates on acknowledged_at IS NULL, so an acked signal leaves the set entirely.

FR-1 DRAIN CADENCE IS BOUNDED: the coordinator write site runs inside printInbox's .limit(20) batch (fleet-dashboard.cjs), and the worker inbox drain is an oldest-5 batch (coordination-inbox.cjs:676). Open QF-20260904-748 reports that the oldest-5 drain exempts only fence_notice. FR-4(d)'s zero worker signals older than 30 minutes with no receipt can fail from batch bounds rather than from a missing write.

MODULE-SYSTEM INTEROP FOR FR-2: lib/worktree-quota.js is ESM (package.json type=module; export const MAX_WORKTREE_COUNT = 40 at line 48). The coordinator tick surfaces are CommonJS .cjs (lib/coordinator/coordination-events.cjs, dispatch.cjs). Reading the cap from a .cjs emitter needs dynamic import(), and duplicating the constant would reintroduce the drift SD-LEO-FIX-WORKTREE-QUOTA-COUNTER-001 already fixed.

ADJACENT OPEN QFs, NOT DUPLICATES BUT SAME SURFACE: QF-20260904-283 (worktree cap enforced only in three caller scripts, not at git worktree add), QF-20260903-936 (releasing a claim leaks the worktree, plus the release-rule broadcast), QF-20260904-748 (oldest-5 drain exemptions). All open and unclaimed. FR-2 should cite them rather than re-derive the cap story.

PARTIAL OVERLAP, SEPARATE LANE: SD-LEO-ORCH-CAPA-DURABILITY-AUDIT-001-D (draft, priority=critical) carries delivery receipts on work assignments in its W6 child scope. Different lane from signal receipts but the same primitive; cross-cite so the two do not build parallel receipt writers.
recommendations: BEFORE LEAD APPROVAL, reconcile SD-LEO-FIX-DELIVERY-RECEIPT-SEVERITY-001 against merged main. Its escalating QF's fix is already in main at 98c3e7f78d8 + 77158a9ce41, so the likely correct action is to close it as delivered and stamp QF-20260906-162 with its pr_url and commit_sha so future dedup reads the truth, then let this SD's FR-1 carry only the widening.

RESTATE FR-2's DELIVERY MECHANISM in the PRD. Three viable shapes in preference order: (1) fan out one directed row per live seat at emit time, since every existing worker drain already reads directed rows and no new reader code is needed; (2) adopt the target_session IS NULL convention that lib/checkin/steps/drain-reservations.cjs:58 already reads, adding a broadcast step under lib/checkin/steps/; (3) add a broadcast union to coordination-inbox.cjs and worker-checkin.cjs. Do not ship a bare target_session='broadcast' row.

RE-ANCHOR FR-3 on insertCoordinationRow (lib/coordinator/dispatch.cjs:1214) using the stamper-guard pattern already established there for effort_recommendation (:448), premise_measured_at (:514) and model_recommendation (:707), each keyed on row.message_type === 'WORK_ASSIGNMENT'. Render holds with the existing resolveHoldProvenance and formatHoldProvenance pair (lib/fleet/claim-eligibility.cjs:718, both exported at :1028) rather than hand-rolling a hold reader.

REUSE THE FIRE-ONCE ALARM PATTERN for FR-2's re-emit window. emitReaperStarvationAlert (lib/coordinator/coordination-events.cjs:855) dedupes by selecting an existing unacknowledged, unexpired row of the same payload kind and returning {ok:true, skipped:true}; expiry does the re-emit windowing, so a 6h expires_at delivers FR-2's at-most-every-6h with no new state file. The inert_worker_alert emitter at :443-472 is the same shape. Per its own S3 comment, give the over-cap and cleared conditions different payload kinds so one cannot suppress the other.

ADD signal_receipt AND the FR-2 broadcast kind to INFORMATIONAL_KINDS (lib/fleet/worker-status.cjs:289) in the same PR that lands QF-20260904-695, per rider (a), and pin the invariant with a test asserting the two lists are unioned rather than swapped.
CREATE AT LEAST ONE sd_backlog_map ROW before moving the SD to active. Four functional requirements make four natural backlog items.

FR-4 FIXTURE HOME ALREADY EXISTS: tests/unit/fleet/ carries the QF-162 suites (fleet-dashboard-signal-receipt.test.js, outstanding-signals.test.js, outstanding-signals-coordinator-wide.test.js, drain-set-registry.test.js). Extend those rather than starting a new directory. The FR-4(d) zero-count assertion must state which batch bound it measured under, or it reads as a clean zero produced by truncation.
